title: The Capital Markets Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) Disclosures and Sustainability Reporting Guidelines, 2026
citation: Capital Markets Authority (ESG Disclosure and Sustainability Reporting) Guidelines, 2026, made under section 29(1)(a) of the Capital Markets Authority Act, Cap. 64
evidence: Closing line of the OCR text of the CMA PDF: "Issued this 2nd day of July 2026." and preamble "these guidelines are made this 2nd day of July 2026"; no commencement clause. Opened https://cmauganda.co.ug/guidelines/ and the linked PDF on 2026-11-05.
notes: Text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (the 14-page file has no text layer); tesseract eng, 300 dpi. The register title was shortened on the old row; the page title is used here. Implementation clause: 2026-2027 voluntary reporting and pilots, 2028 mandatory reporting for listed issuers and large fund managers, 1 January 2030 full compliance, assurance and enforcement; non-compliance carries administrative sanctions (public censure) and false statements the penalties of section 14 of the Act. in_force is the issue date because the text has no commencement clause; the mandatory dates are later. The April 2026 exposure draft on cmauganda.co.ug/draft-laws is not stored. English is the only language the CMA serves; no Kiswahili text was found. Row passes on the statute reading flagged in the row; Varun to confirm.

title: The National Climate Change (Climate Change Mechanisms) Regulations, 2025
citation: S.I. 2025 No. 9, made under sections 8, 9, 12 and 29 of the National Climate Change Act, Cap. 182; Uganda Gazette No. 6, Vol. CXVIII, 24 January 2025 (Statutory Instruments Supplement No. 3)
evidence: Header of the PDF: "STATUTORY INSTRUMENTS SUPPLEMENT No. 3  24th January, 2025 ... to The Uganda Gazette No. 6, Volume CXVIII, dated 24th January, 2025"; "these Regulations are made this 7th day of November, 2024". No commencement clause. Opened https://mwe.go.ug/publications/194/download on 2026-11-05.
notes: Informally the carbon market regulations. in_force is the gazette date because the text has no commencement clause; the regulations were made on 7 November 2024. Reg 45 keeps approvals granted before commencement valid until 31 December 2027. The same file is also on https://www.nema.go.ug/en/regulations/. English only; the gazette is enacted in English. Implements ug-national-climate-change-act-2021.

title: The National Environment (Environmental and Social Assessment) Regulations, 2020
citation: S.I. 2020 No. 143, made under section 179 of the National Environment Act, 2019; Uganda Gazette No. 85, Vol. CXIII, 21 December 2020 (Statutory Instruments Supplement No. 44)
evidence: Header of the PDF: "STATUTORY INSTRUMENTS SUPPLEMENT No. 44  21st December, 2020 ... to The Uganda Gazette No. 85, Volume CXIII, dated 21st December, 2020"; "these Regulations are made this 11th day of October, 2019". No commencement clause. Opened the NEMA PDF on 2026-11-05.
notes: Environmental and social assessment duties of developers under the National Environment Act 2019 (project briefs, ESIAs, certificates). in_force is the gazette date; the text says made 11 October 2019 and has no commencement clause. English only. Other NEMA regulations (audit S.I. 47/2020, waste management S.I. 49/2020, air quality S.I. 22/2024 and the rest of the list on /en/regulations/) were not reached.

title: The National Climate Change Act, 2021
evidence: No official page states it. Section 1 of the MWE PDF reads "This Act shall come into force on a date to be appointed by the Minister by statutory instrument." and the front matter has blank "Date of Assent:" and "Date of Commencement:" lines; no commencement instrument was found. Opened https://mwe.go.ug/publications/192/download on 2026-11-05.
notes: Link only: the MWE copy is an unsigned supplement draft ("ACTS SUPPLEMENT No. ..... May, 2021", gazette number and dates blank, 123 pages with the UN treaties attached), and no official page gives the commencement date, so no dated record can be made. Cap. 182 comes from the text of S.I. 2025 No. 9, which cites "National Climate Change Act, Cap. 182". ULII lists assent 14 August 2021 and publication 31 December 2021 (secondary, not used). Sections 5-6 (action plans), 10-13 (emissions measurement and reporting) and 23 (duties of private entities) are the ESG-relevant parts. English only; looked for in Kiswahili on mwe.go.ug and found none.

title: The National Environment Act, 2019
citation: National Environment Act, 2019 (Act 5 of 2019; Cap. 181 on the NEMA page); Uganda Gazette No. 10, Vol. CXII, 7 March 2019 (Acts Supplement No. 2)
evidence: No official page states it. Section 1 of the NEMA PDF reads "This Act shall come into force on a date to be appointed by the Minister by statutory instrument, and different dates may be appointed for the commencement of different provisions."; "DATE OF ASSENT: 24th February, 2019."; "Date of Commencement: See section 1". Opened the PDF on 2026-11-05.
notes: Link only: the commencement date is appointed by statutory instrument and none was found on an official page; assent (24 February 2019) and gazette (7 March 2019) are not commencement. English only. Amends nothing in scope; implemented by ug-esa-regs-2020.

title: Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Guidelines for the Insurance Sector, 2026
citation: Insurance Regulatory Authority of Uganda, ESG Guidelines for the Insurance Sector 2026, issued under cover of circular IRA/CIR/03/26/1195 of 9 March 2026 (section 11(1) of the Insurance Act)
evidence: OCR of the IRA PDF, circular IRA/CIR/03/26/1195 dated "9th March, 2026": "The Authority hereby issues guidelines to the industry to: i. Provide the industry with guidance (soft guidelines) on adopting ESG in their work processes ... iii. Prepare the sector for mandatory reporting in line with the ICPAU Road map and the IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards in 2028." Downloaded from https://ira.go.ug/download/esg-guidelines/ on 2026-11-05. No commencement clause; circular date used.
notes: Link only: licence row UG-IRA-ADOPTED is permission requested (site footer "All rights reserved"), and the guidelines are soft guidance, not an enactment. The 77-page PDF is image-only. The IRA page lists the file as updated 29 April 2026; the circular date is used. Mandatory reporting is stated for 2028.
